details: The slider `input` handler calls `render()` synchronously on every tick without debouncing or RAF, triggering expensive `d3.hexbin()` binning of 20,000 points at up to 60fps during drag; the `pointermove` handler does use a dirty-flag check (`closest !== hoveredBin`) to avoid redundant redraws, but each triggered render still re-bins all points. No transitions exist (canvas-only), no cross-view dispatch, and pointer events API eliminates the mouse/touch fight.
